summary: Two girls in an Indiana school group became woozy on the Blue Lakes Trail/Blaine Basin; hasty team assessed them and escorted the group to the trailhead and lower elevation, all okay.
notes: Altitude-sickness-like symptoms; second team staged for a possible litter evacuation but not needed. OMRT notes this was the same group needing rescue services in 2018.
